1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) wherein said molecular analysis includes genotyping; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme that is not a cell wall degrading enzyme.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos irrespective of their developmental stage.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping, which may include single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype prior to germination.
